_about: Ghenna, the city of evil (levels 26-33), peopled from its original area files (circle-contrib-areas/ghenna, by Drip/Nosferatu): its creatures and where they stood, with ranks: the Gorgimera, the Ghenna Swordmaster and the Efreeti as sub-bosses, six elites, the city's evil answering each other's cry, and the Deep Dragon in its lair, spitting acid and darkening the cave. Left out: four crude joke characters.

9900.name: shamus wanderer
9900.long_desc: Shamus, the wandering liege, wants to protect you from the evil here.
9900.description:
You see a human male, bald of head and thick of frame, wearing a white
robe. He has heard tales of this city of evil, and has come here as a
missionary.

9902.name: banshee
9902.long_desc: The groaning spirit of a long-dead woman floats here.
9902.description:
This is the spirit of an evil female elf, a very rare thing indeed. Her
hair is wild and unkempt, and she is dressed in tattered rags.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9903.name: argos
9903.long_desc: A multi-mouthed pseudopod of great girth is standing here.
9903.description:
This is a large, amoeba-like being with one central eye which has a
tripartite pupil, and a hundred lashless inhuman eyes set above many
sharp-toothed mouths..

9904.name: bugbear
9904.long_desc: A tall Bugbear stands here, poised for action.
9904.description:
Large and very muscular, this guy is covered in brick red fur. Though
vaguely humanoid in appearance, he seems to contain the blood of some
large carnivore.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9905.name: broken
9905.long_desc: A Broken One stands here looking gruesome.
9905.description:
This guy sure is ugly! He has the head of an ogre, one webbed foot, one
human foot, and various other body parts that don't match.

9906.name: bullywug
9906.long_desc: A Bullywug is standing here, ready to defend his master's lair.
9906.description: This guy looks kinda like a ninja turtle, except he's a frog.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9907.name: plant
9907.long_desc: A large plant that reeks of carrion stands here stinking up the place.
9907.description: You see a giant, venus fly trap with 6 inch fangs.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9908.name: gorgimera
9908.long_desc: A Gorgimera roars at your entrance, and ATTACKS!!!
9908.description:
This monster has three heads, those of a gorgon, a lion, and a fierce
dragon. It has the hindquarters of a large, black gorgon and the
forequarters of a huge, tawny lion, with brownish-black wings like those
of a dragon.

9909.name: death knight
9909.long_desc: A Death Knight stands here, lowering at you.
9909.description:
A hulking skeleton, its face a blackened skull covered with shards of
shriveled rotting flesh, chillingly returns your gaze.

9910.name: deep dragon
9910.long_desc: A large snake sits here, munching on a human body.
9910.description:
The Deep dragon is an iridescent maroon colored beast about 25 feet
long. Known for assuming various shapes, this animal is highly dangerous
and you would do best to exit its lair immediately.

phases.message: The Deep Dragon sheds its snake-shape and roars in its true form!

abilities.name: Shape of Terror
abilities.telegraph: The Deep Dragon swells to its full size and rears over you!

abilities.name: Crushing Coils
abilities.telegraph: The Deep Dragon coils to strike!

abilities.name: Acid Gout
abilities.telegraph: The Deep Dragon draws back its head, acid hissing between its fangs!

9911.name: derro
9911.long_desc: The Derro is standing here, barking orders.
9911.description:
You see a dwarf with glowing white eyes which have no pupils. His skin
is pasty white, but he looks stout enough.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9912.name: elf
9912.long_desc: An errant Elf is here, looking for denizens of evil.
9912.description:
You see an attractive young man, about 5 feet tall, with gleaming eyes
and a pale complexion. Though small, he appears to be very lithe and
agile.

9913.name: efreeti genie
9913.long_desc: A Genie is levitating here with an evil grin on his face.
9913.description:
You see a powerful mage naked to the waist, wearing only a pair of
slippers, some baggy purple pants, and a bracelet which sparkles with a
multi-hued color.

9914.name: medusa
9914.long_desc: A woman sits here on the bed, with her back to you.
9914.description:
Well, you probably shouldn't have looked at this chick, cause she sure
is ugly. But I guess you are about to see HOW ugly.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9915.name: stupid orc
9915.long_desc: A big, stupid Orc is lumbering through here.
9915.description: He's just ugly as sin... lets leave it at that.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9916.name: barkeep
9916.long_desc: There is a barkeep standing here, waiting to take your order.
9916.description:
The barkeep is a waifish little guy, with safety pins piercing the flesh
all over his face... he even has safety pins through his eyelids.

9917.name: citizen
9917.long_desc: A citizen of Ghenna stands here.
9917.description:
You see a grungy human, long since gone insane at the fall of his once
proud city.

9918.name: cosmetics seller old lady
9918.long_desc: A lost old lady in pink chiffon tries to sell you some makeup.
9918.description:
You see a little old lady, dressed all in pink chiffon. On her arm she
carries a heart shaped box made of crepe paper.

9923.name: swordmaster
9923.long_desc: A broad shouldered man lies prostrate here, apparently praying.
9923.description:
A huge man with a long black beard, the Ghenna Swordmaster is tatooed
with rune-like scars from head to toe. Shrouded in vermillion, he wields
a sword of stunning beauty, which sings through the air as he attacks
you.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9931.name: wall foot
9931.short_desc: a claw toed foot protruding from the wall
9931.long_desc: A clawed foot juts out of the wall here, toes twitching.
9931.description: It looks just like a foot sticking out of the wall.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9932.name: wall arm
9932.short_desc: a claw fingered arm protruding from the wall
9932.long_desc: A clawed arm reaches out of the wall here, fingers grasping.
9932.description: It looks just like an arm sticking out of the wall.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9933.name: statue stone golem
9933.long_desc: A large statue of a humanoid male has been cut out of the granite here.
9933.description:
It looks like a stone sculpture of Frankenstein's monster. It stands
twelve feet tall, casting a long shadow over you.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9964.name: doll golem
9964.long_desc: A doll sits here leaning against the wall, forgotten by the child who owns it.
9964.description:
This looks like your typical child's doll. Its about one foot tall, and
looks like it is made of plastic.

9985.name: maedar
9985.long_desc: A Maedar stands here in the darkness smacking his lips.
9985.description: You see a muscular, hairless humanoid male dressed in a tunic.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9986.name: maedar master
9986.long_desc: A Maedar stands here in the darkness smacking his lips.
9986.description: You see a muscular, hairless humanoid male dressed in a tunic.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9987.name: roger dodger
9987.long_desc: Roger, the elven apostle is looking for evil guys to kill here.
9987.description:
You see a young elf, only about 130 years old, who acts as though he is
on a crusade. Dressed in light armor, he seeks out evil doers in order
to eradicate them from the face of the planet.

9989.name: deep dragon dragonet
9989.long_desc: A wimpy little dragon is standing here, looking at you with deep blue eyes.
9989.description:
You see what appears to be a tiny dragon, about the size of a chihuahua.
What a pansy he is too!

9994.name: cockroach
9994.long_desc: The biggest cockroach you have ever seen is standing here, looking down at you.
9994.description: You see a cockroach about 8 feet tall - apparently a mutant breed.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

9997.name: deepspawn
9997.long_desc: The Deepspawn is standing here, ready to kill you.
9997.description:
It looks like a large, rubbery shpere of mottled grey and brown. Six
arms project from its body; three are tentacle-arms, and three are jaw-
arms, ending in mouths of many teeth. It also has about 40 long,
retractable, flexible eye stalks that wave at you menacingly.

helpers.shout: A cry goes up, and the evil of Ghenna gathers!

bosses.why: the Deep Dragon in its lair

mechanics.label: Acid Pool
mechanics.why: acid where it spits: step out

mechanics.shout: The Deep Dragon coils around the light, and the lair goes dark...

48190.description: A crude iron ball bristling with nails on a short ash haft, sized for a bugbear's fist.

48191.room_desc: An orcish scale shirt lies here.
48191.description: A shirt of uneven iron scales riveted to greasy leather. It has seen many owners.

48192.room_desc: A pair of black greaves lies here.
48192.description: Black steel greaves etched with runes that drink the light, cold as a winter grave.

48193.room_desc: A long, perfectly balanced blade lies here.
48193.description: A long sword of blued steel, so finely balanced it seems to move before you do. The Swordmaster killed a hundred challengers with it in his arena.

48194.short_desc: a fistful of the deep dragon's hoard-gems
48194.room_desc: A scatter of acid-etched gems lies here.
48194.description: Rubies and dark sapphires, their facets etched dull by the dragon's breath. Still worth a fortune.

48195.short_desc: a cloak of deep dragon hide
48195.room_desc: A cloak of purple-black dragon hide lies here.
48195.description: A cloak of the deep dragon's supple purple-black hide, proof against acid and cold.
